_comment: FAST companion to gauntlet.json for quick directional checks when you can't wait for 2+1. TC 5+0.05 (tiny increment) runs ~6x faster per game than 2+1 while keeping enough base time to avoid time-loss artifacts (used throughout this session with no flagging). TRADEOFFS vs the 2+1 config: (1) less depth -> weaker Chez, so the opponent ladder is shifted DOWN (2400-3000) to keep cells in the informative 30-70% band; (2) absolute Elo is NOT comparable to the 2+1 gauntlet - use this for relative A/B (regression checks, tuning sweeps), not for an absolute rating claim; (3) rounds=40 (80 games/opp, ~+/-80 Elo CI) trades precision for speed - bump to 100 if a cell looks borderline. Same machine assumptions as gauntlet.json: threads=4 x concurrency=3 = 15/16 cores, clean timing. SF Threads=1 (skill fixed by UCI_Elo). Total ~240 games ~= 15-20 min on 16 cores.
